subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI issue remain as the coordination umbrella, or should maintainers split it between the structured reply-metadata path and the durable final-fallback delivery contract?
rationale: Current main only partially addresses the report, and the remaining work spans Gateway protocol shape, agent runtime metadata, and channel final-delivery semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Split Across Existing Contracts
options.body: Use the structured reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for the reply half, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final-fallback delivery semantics, and close this issue only once both halves are represented.

options.title: Keep Combined Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface Control UI tracker until one maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX together.

options.title: Defer Structured Reply Metadata
options.body: Treat Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI for now and track only the final-fallback delivery contract as remaining work.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Contracts
recommendation.body: Use the structured reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for the reply half, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final-fallback delivery semantics, and close this issue only once both halves are represented.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal is recent work across the Control UI send path, Gateway chat schema, and runtime-context helper boundary.
